Name: Persistent Work Areas
Description: Pin farm, forester, lumberjack and other navigation-based working-area outlines. Planting tools also outline the farmhouses or foresters that plant the chosen crop or tree, and pins are remembered per settlement in a local file, never in the save. Clear all pins from the top-right button or a configurable key binding. Local display only; designed for compatibility with the BeaverBuddies Stability Fork.
